rules.condition: i_wr_en = 1 and full = 0 and not in software reset
rules.statement: When i_wr_en = 1 and full = 0, the FIFO accepts the write and stores the word.
A write while full = 1 must be rejected (word not stored) and overflow must be raised.

rules.condition: i_rd_en = 1 and empty = 0 and not in software reset
rules.statement: When i_rd_en = 1 and empty = 0, the FIFO accepts the read and the read pointer advances.
A read while empty = 1 must be rejected (pointer not advanced) and underflow must be raised.

rules.condition: write and read occur simultaneously in different clock domains
rules.statement: Simultaneous write and read are allowed; the write and read interfaces operate independently in their different clock domains.
When i_rst_n_sw is low for one cycle or more, the FIFO performs a four-phase handshake, blocks both interfaces and resets the pointers.

rules.condition: i_wr_en or i_rd_en = 1 during the software reset
rules.statement: Writes or reads during the software reset must not be accepted and must not generate an error pulse.
Interface signals are sampled on the rising edge of the respective domain clock.
i_wr_data is captured at the accepting edge, so no hold of i_wr_data after that edge is required.
The FIFO has no interrupt output.
The integrator derives an interrupt from the overflow and underflow flags.
